evidence.title: GitHub - Leonxlnx/taste-skill: Taste-Skill - gives your AI good taste. stops the AI from generating boring, generic slop

name: Taste Skill
summary: Agent skills that upgrade AI-built frontends: layout, typography, motion and spacing rules instead of boilerplate.
description: A collection of 15 agent skills installed with npx skills add. The flagship design-taste-frontend (v2) reads the brief and tunes VARIANCE / MOTION / DENSITY dials; other skills cover a stricter GPT/Codex variant, redesign audits, minimalist, industrial-brutalist and high-end visual styles, full-output enforcement and image-to-code workflows, plus image-generation skills for website comps, mobile flows and brand kits. Rules are framework-agnostic across React, Vue, Svelte and other stacks.
contains: flagship design-taste-frontend v2 with VARIANCE / MOTION / DENSITY dials
image-generation skills for web comps, mobile flows and brand kits
